{{Quote|It's not the profitable thing, but it's the right thing. It's what Han would do. What kind of leader am I if I don't follow that example?|Lilli|<ref name="VEaA" />}}
'''Lillindri Nanimei Filda Vandelhelm XXXII''', commonly known as '''Lilli''', was one of the [[Venerated Ones]], the scion of the metalsmithing dynasty on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vandelhelm/Legends|Vandelhelm]]. Lilli and her younger brother [[Endrodanar Tiopuld Shaamador Vandelhelm XXIV|Endro]] were kidnapped during their youth by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] on [[Ord Vaug]], as their status as living symbols of Vandelhelm's biggest industry made them extremely valuable hostages. After three years' confinement, the siblings were rescued by the [[Alliance of Free Planets]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], and returned home by Alliance hero [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]. Lilli was shortly afterward voted as the new [[Guild Master/Legends|Guildmaster]] of the planet's [[Metalsmiths Guild]], where she maintained a strong loyalty to the Alliance's successor [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], which earned her enemies and even an [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] attempt from her own brother.

==Biography==
{{Quote|The Guild thinks I don't know they're unhappy. They say I won't listen. Yet when I send Endro to explain my position, I get nowhere. Freedom from the constraints the Empire imposed on them made the smiths greedy for ever more credits once the occupiers had gone. Greed is repulsive in those who already have so much.|Lilli|<ref name="SW98" />}}
Lillindri Nanimei Filda Vandelhelm XXXII, known as "Lilli" for short, was&mdash;by the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]&mdash;one of the last living descendants of [[Vandel]] and [[Helm]], independent prospectors who discovered her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Vandelhelm/Legends|Vandelhelm]] around [[3000 BBY]] and founded its metalsmithing dynasty. The two families intermarried extensively over the ensuing millennia, and their descendants became known as the [[Venerated Ones]] by the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Metalsmiths Guild]], holding tremendous symbolic importance to the industry. Lilli and her brother [[Endrodanar Tiopuld Shaamador Vandelhelm XXIV]]&mdash;or simply "Endro"&mdash;were essentially hereditary royalty, and the extremely lucrative metalsmithing industry on Vandelhelm traditionally shut down entirely if the Venerated Ones were absent from the planet or refused to give their blessing.<ref name="VEaA" />

[[File:Venerated_Ones_of_Vandelhelm.png|thumb|left|250px|The Venerated Ones of Vandelhelm in 5 ABY.]]
One exception occurred in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], when sitting [[Guild Master/Legends|Guildmaster]] [[Orrk]] conspired with [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Mordur]] to have the two young Venerated Ones arrested and [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] in an internment facility on [[Ord Vaug]], in order to exert greater control over the metalsmiths. The siblings languished on Ord Vaug for three years before they were finally [[Liberation of Ord Vaug|freed]] by the [[Alliance of Free Planets]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="VEaA" /> Lilli and Endro returned to their homeworld in an Alliance [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'' crewed by one-time [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] heroes [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Nien Nunb/Legends|Nien Nunb]].<ref name="SW98" />

Their return was covertly [[Mission to Vandelhelm|opposed]] by Orrk and Mordur, who [[Mine/Legends|mined]] the [[Vandelhelm system/Legends|Vandelhelm system's]] [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]], but the children reached Vandelhelm safely to a rapturous response from the public. However, Orrk made his move the first chance he got with the children, attempting to take Lilli hostage with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]. In the ensuing struggle Lilli managed to wrest the gun away from Orrk, firing a shot that threw him off balance and allowed Solo to throw Orrk to his death over a railing. Lilli then foiled Mordur's plot to send a shipment of materials into the [[Vandelhelm (star)|sun]] instead of allowing it to reach the Alliance [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]], sending the command codes for the metalsmiths' [[Drone barge/Legends|drone barges]] to an Alliance [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] so they could be shut down. Solo was surprised at Lilli's ingenuity, concluding what the young Venerated One saw as a "fun adventure."<ref name="SW98" />

Lilli replaced Orrk as Guildmaster by popular vote only a day after Solo's departure, aged just 15. Grateful to her rescuers and seeing Solo's example as one she should follow, she fostered very close relations with the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] during its early years, keeping prices down for the New Republic and refusing to sell metal to any who would call themselves Imperial. These policies led to a plateauing of profits, and in turn tension with smiths made greedy by freedom from Imperial constraints. She leaned heavily on her younger brother Endro during this time as her security advisor, spokesperson and liaison to the guild. Amid whispers of dissatisfaction among the smiths, Lilli ordered the guild to fulfill a massive shipbuilding job for the New Republic, requiring a large amount of Vandelhelm's finest alloys to create the [[Solo-class combat freighter|''Solo''-class combat freighter]] in time for the 10 year anniversary of the return of the Venerated Ones.<ref name="VEaA" />

To celebrate the anniversary, Lilli personally invited Solo and Nunb to return to Vandelhelm for festivities and the unveiling of the new freighter line that bore Solo's name. However, the ceremony quickly turned disastrous. As Lilli handed the control codes for the freighters to Solo, a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] belonging to Endro suddenly fired its [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannon]] at Solo, an [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] attempt only foiled by Nunb's timely intervention. Endro was immediately implicated as the trigger man for a plot to replace Lilli as the only remaining Venerated One, in order to sell the ''Solo''-class freighters to the highest bidder. The plan foiled, the ''Solo''-class freighters were safely delivered to the New Republic.<ref name="VEaA" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|If the Rebel Alliance ever wants us to travel anywhere else, we're going to insist only ''you'' can be our pilot... Han."<br />"Call me General.|Lilli and Han Solo|<ref name="SW98" />}}
Going by the shortened name "Lilli" unless protocol absolutely demanded it, Lillindri Nanimei Filda Vandelhelm XXXII was, by her mid-20s, considered a striking young woman, bred and educated from birth to lead. Although highly educated, Lilli's royal upbringing left her with somewhat stunted social skills, and she was noted for her idealism. Lilli's suffering at the hands of her Imperial captors instilled in her a deep revulsion for the Empire, and led to her refusing to work with the Imperials&mdash;a stand that led to tension with the metalsmiths who were used to profiting from all sides willing to pay. Lilli was disgusted with what she saw as the metalsmiths' greed, feeling that it was the right thing to repay what she saw as her own personal debt to the New Republic, regardless of what it meant for profit.<ref name="VEaA" /> 

Beyond just being her rescuer, Lilli saw Han Solo as her role model, looking to him as the example she wanted to follow as a leader.<ref name="VEaA" /> Lilli was quickly enamored with Solo as a youth<ref name="SW98" /> and she maintained that personal interest as an adult, as she wrote in her private [[Holojournal/Legends|holojournal]] of her jealousy of Solo's marriage with New Republic [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], and hoped to convince him to stay with her on Vandelhelm. In her personal time, Lilli enjoyed [[Sculptor/Legends|sculpting]] small metal figures in her royal studio, and practicing martial arts for both practical and relaxation purposes. Lilli went armed at all times as a matter of tradition, and as such was skilled with a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]].<ref name="VEaA" /> 

==Behind the scenes==
Lilli appeared in [[Star Wars (1977) 98|''Star Wars'' (1977) 98]], written by [[Archie Goodwin]] and released in [[1985]].<ref name="SW98" /> Her full name was later given in the [[2004]] [[Wizards of the Coast]] supplement ''[[Vandelhelm: Enemies and Alloys]]'', written by [[Cory J. Herndon]].<ref name="VEaA" />
